removal_rule.membership: team_at(pid, cutoff) returns the team of the last event at or before the cutoff, None if that event is a 'leave' or is more than HIST_DAYS old; roster() keeps a candidate when team_at equals the team, or when the report lists him and team_at is None
removal_rule.join_events_emitted_for: any transaction with a destination team
gaps: a transaction that is neither a waiver nor has a destination team emits no event, so the player stays on his previous team's list until an appearance elsewhere or 365 days pass
a player whose name cannot be matched to an identifier is skipped, so none of his movements register at all
a transaction is stamped at 12:00Z on its date, so one announced later in the day is treated as known at a cutoff six hours before an evening tip
removal_rule.movement_log: the league player-movement feed, stats.nba.com/js/data/playermovement/NBA_Player_Movement.json, as fetched by the originating project

note: The proxy is a reference-rotation player who never appears for that team again in the season. It is not an error on its own, so the quantity rule V-e reads is the ratio between team-games near a transaction and team-games away from one.

boundary.note: The proxy is vacuously true in a team's last game, so the rule reads the rows with games still to come.

rule_V_e: The proxy is not concentrated near transactions, so the removal rule is not visibly leaking; Table 1 states the rule and this is reported as a negative result.
